date_note: The source identifies the Colony census only by year. It explicitly gives no census for the Protectorate. The Protectorate figure has no separate headcount date. The note on p. 142 states that the 1891 Colony total of 74,835 covers a different geographical area from the 1901 total.
boundary_note: The Colony return of 76,655 includes the Sierra Leone Peninsula subtotal of 67,782, Sherbro 5,490, Isles de Los 1,422, Tassoh 1,079 and Kikonkeh 882. Freetown district's 34,463 is included in the Peninsula subtotal. The separate Protectorate estimate of 949,827 includes Ronietta 400,000, Karene 200,000, Bandajuma 109,584, Panguma 183,857 and Koinadugu 56,386. The separate Colony and Protectorate totals and their district detail are already in collections/eastern. The roster reflects administrative reporting boundaries. For example, the 1896 delimitation ordinance treated some still legally colonial areas as part of the Protectorate for administration. The combined statistical scope has no exact opening-map crosswalk. The WWO CShapes Sierra Leone polygon ends at longitude 13.2932 degrees west and therefore excludes Isles de Los. Its eastern extent includes Kailahun, which the 1911 treaty returned to the British side in exchange for other territory after the 1903 demarcation. Removing only Isles de Los does not establish a boundary match.
